name: Save Profiles
author: After juvxncio's zelda-oot-perfis (GPL-3.0-or-later)
description: An N64-style file select with 30 files on 5 pages, opened by the title's Continue; a pick opens that file's save list, B on it comes back, and B goes back to the title. Each file is its own game: its own saves, settings and progress. Export and Import copy a file to and from Documents\Squadala saves. In co-op the host shares the file it picked; guests play the host's save as before.

settings.name: Skip the file select
settings.help: Only for co-op before mod interface 2, where the file select shows at the start. On: the game opens the file you played last. Off (the default): pick a file each time. With interface 2 the title's Continue opens it.
